title.hr: Politika, standard, procedura, zapis: trag kojim ide revizor
title.en: Policy, standard, procedure, record: the auditor's trail

concept.hr: Prvi sloj koji nedostaje prekida trag; zapisi bez politike ne vrijede
concept.en: The first missing layer breaks the trail; records without a policy do not count

summary.hr: Revizor ide od zahtjeva do zapisa za cijelu godinu: prekid iznad zapisa je nalaz o oblikovanju, zapisi koji nedostaju nalaz o provedbi.
summary.en: The auditor walks from a requirement to the records for the whole year: a break above them is a design finding, missing records an operating one.

concept.hr: Sve je napisano, a zapisa nema: nalaz o provedbi
concept.en: Everything is written and no record exists: an operating finding
